newsitem.title: POLAND: SWARZEDZ TO ISSUE EX-RIGHTS SHARES.
newsitem.headline: SWARZEDZ TO ISSUE EX-RIGHTS SHARES.

text.p: Polish furniture maker Swarzedz SA's planned share issue is likely to be ex-rights, the firm's president said on Sunday.
"We want the issue to be ex-rights. This is the proposal for the shareholders' meeting on June 6," Julian Nuckowski told a news conference.
But he said Swarzedz's current shareholders would be the first to be offered shares from the issue. "It would practically be like an unformalised rights issue," he said.

Nuckowski said he would like to complete the issue in several weeks and not months as was earlier planned. "We have to have money, which we need because the company is selling more and more," he said.
He confirmed that Swarzedz was in talks with several investors from the furniture sector on selling them part of the issue.
The company earlier said Germany's International Moebelhandelskantor Gmbh & Co KH (IMK), a part of Schieder Group, was one such investor.
Swarzedz plans to issue the 3.125 million shares to creditors and another 3.5 million shares to other investors.
